regions.merged_text: I am glad to know that your Mother feels well enough and is looking forward to making the little trip down to our Monastery here just up over the hill from Huntington. I think an experienced driver ought to be able to make the trip easily enough in five or six hours. It is only about 125 miles from Chicago, and it ought not be difficult to cut off fifty of that by a straighter route, e.g. via South Bend, Elkart or Coldwater. This last might be out of your way but in case there is a direct highway from the North I could guide you pretty well from that point. The Fathers of Detroit and Huntington usually go that way when driving. Its just 100 miles out of Detroit. That would be to far Eastward for you. Well we'll just pray the dear Lord to be your Guide - Maybe as He was to the young Tobias, through St. Raphael.
